pages.ja:
……ここから動けない。
“できるなら逃げなさい”なんて、そんな言葉に頷けるほど物分りは良くはない。
かといってバーサーカーの後を追う事もできない。

pages.en:
…I can't move from this spot.

I can't simply nod and do as Tohsaka tells me when she says, *“Run, if you can.”*

But neither can I bring myself to follow Berserker.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…I can’t move from here.
‘If you can, try to run away.’
I’m not obedient enough to follow her words.
But I can’t go after Berserker either.

pages.ja:
あの怪物と向かい合う事への恐怖もあるが、
何より
俺が駆けつけたところで、一体何ができるというのか。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
I am afraid to face that monster, yes.

But more than that—what could I possibly do even if I rushed to Saber's side?
pages.mirrorMoon:
I’m scared of going up against that monster.
But more than thatwhat can I do even if I go?

……悔しいが、俺には戦う力が欠けている。
俺ではセイバーを助ける事も、バーサーカーと戦う事も出来ない。
出来る事といったら、今のうちに安全な場所に逃げ出す事だけだ。

pages.en:
“D—damn it.”

I stand alone in the night.

…It galls me to admit it, but I have no power to fight.

I cannot help Saber. I cannot fight Berserker.

The only thing I can do is flee somewhere safe while I still have the chance.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Damnit.”
I stand by myself in the dark.
…It’s vexing, but I have no way to fight.
I can neither help Saber nor fight Berserker.
If there’s anything I can do, it’s run to a safe place right now.

pages.ja:
「！？」
坂の上
セイバーが弾き飛ばされた荒れ地から、聞きなれない音が聞こえてくる。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“!?”

An unfamiliar sound reaches me from the top of the hill—from the wasteland where Saber was thrown.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“!?”
I hear unfamiliar noises from the top of the hillfrom the open area that Saber was flung into.

pages.ja:
……あそこは確か、広い外人墓地の筈だ。
セイバーとバーサーカー。
二人の戦いはまだ続いているらしい。
pages.jaRuby:

…There should be a sprawling foreign cemetery up there.

Saber and Berserker.

It seems their battle is still going on.

If I remember correctly, that’s the foreigners’ cemetery.
Saber and Berserker.
Their fight must still be going on.
